issues.title: Ambiguous Concurrency/Partial Failure in CI Gates
issues.why: While AC-CG-27 defines a fail-fast policy, it doesn't specify how the linter should handle race conditions or file-locking when scanning 251 files across 5 runtimes simultaneously.
issues.fix: Add a clause to AC-CG-27 requiring linter scripts to use deterministic sequential scanning or explicit file-locking for shared report artifacts.

issues.title: Inconsistent Boolean Prefix Regex
issues.why: The TS contract defines BOOLEAN_NAME_REGEX as /^(is|has|should|can|will|did|was)[A-Z]/, but the human-readable summary in 00-overview only lists is/has/should.
issues.fix: Sync the overview text to include 'can/will/did/was' to match the normative TS contract.

issues.title: Dangling Reference to PowerShell/Research
issues.why: 00-overview lists folders 09 and 10 as having 0 files, and AC-CG-17 marks them as placeholders, which might confuse an AI looking for automation standards.
issues.fix: Add a 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' status to the Subfolder Delegation Map for slots 09 and 10.
